 The Melbourne Renegades have announced their squad for the opening game of the WBBL|12 season against the Sydney Thunder at Junction Oval.
 The Final XI will be confirmed at the toss, with Australian T20 World Cup winning captain Sophie Molineux to lead the side.
It will be a milestone double-header, with the lights to be turned on at Junction Oval for the first time in a WBBL match.
 Fans will also have additional seating options with new grandstands installed for both the WBBL and BBL seasons.
